MEAN_REVERSION._symbols_note: ABEV and ABM have NO bars in equities_data.ohlcv_1d (data-owner ask DO-ABEV/ABM). The live runner's freshness guard treats a requested symbol with no bars as absent and refuses a bare live run, so the LIVE runtime config keeps the universe the 2026-09 gate proved (BKNG and DD in their place) until those bars exist; swap back here-to-runtime when they do. var_limit lives in risk.json (0.25, proven).

_use_optimization_note: false: the equity runners hard-code the optimizer off (live_equity_mean_reversion.cpp, bt_equity_mean_reversion.cpp; HD 2026-09-01) and refuse to start if this says true.
_covariance_history_prices_note: daily closes per symbol the PortfolioManager keeps for the optimiser covariance, one per date, oldest dropped first; absent means 756 (the trend sleeve own cap); at least 2
_covariance_stale_dates_note: how many dates of the union of the covariance symbols' dates a symbol's last close may trail the newest before the optimiser leaves it out of the date intersection (its column becomes the guarded 0.01 variance, WARN COVARIANCE_STALE_PARTICIPANT); at exactly this many it stays; absent means 5; a whole number of at least 0, e.g. 3 to leave out a symbol more than three dates stale
